folds.heading: ## Later selected path-rule coverage, 2026-11-04 (B35)
folds.body: The October13 blanket wiki-not-read statement is baseline history. pass-2026-10-14/CHECKPOINT.md records selected reading of 44 rule pages and a 57-enum/51-special-path table with restrictions, distinguishing mechanics, rewards and evidence labels. Preserve the twelve detailed-page/nested-strategy gaps and the separation of KoLmafia client data, dated rule text and current authoritative server legality/rewards. The later selected-page evidence does not prove every path, live account behavior or save/offline semantics. No account or server operation was performed in this reconciliation.
